name: tenants_add_pay_band
description: Add a pay band. A band matches on whichever of role_family_id, role_id (both from frameworks_get), level_ordinal (the level number, 1 for a role's first level) and location it is given; one left out matches anything. Give a role or a role family, not both. level_id instead matches one framework level, follows it when the framework renumbers it, and keeps pricing its seats once it leaves. The bands form an ordered list: of the bands that match a seat, the last has the last word. A new band lands after the last band no narrower than it; tenants_reorder_pay_bands moves it. A location is a country, matched to the Org Graph's country ignoring case, or blank for any location. Two bands can't match on exactly the same fields; use tenants_change_pay_band to change one. Currency is an ISO 4217 code and period is year, month or hour; figures are kept as entered, never converted or annualised. Figures are decimal strings with at most two decimal places, such as "120000". Refused unless the caller is a tenant admin.
